input.summary: Give AP a 90-day no-cause exit at any time and confine Kubient's convenience termination to the end of the then-current Term.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have limited the Initial Term lock-in to Kubient and removed the "following the Initial Term" restriction so AP may terminate for convenience at any time on 90 days' notice, and added a proviso confining any Kubient termination under that sentence to the end of the then-current Term. This is our fallback position; the mutual 90 days' notice and the fee entitlement are unchanged.

ops.oldText: Neither Party may terminate this Agreement during the Initial Term except as set forth in paragraph 4(b) or any Exhibit. Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other Party.
ops.newText: Kubient may not terminate this Agreement during the Initial Term except as set forth in paragraph 4(b) or any Exhibit. Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other Party, provided that any termination by Kubient under this sentence shall be effective only at the end of the then-current Term.
